senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שָׁמַר)guard, esp. a division for duty of priests and Levites.
units: <cite ref="Horayot 13a:14">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>ראש מ׳</he> chief of the guard. Taan. l. c. <he>ישראל שבאותו מ׳</he> the Israelites attached (as <cite ref="M02143"><he>מַעֲמָד</he></cite>) to that division; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁמָרוֹת</he>. Ib.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (= אַשְׁמוֹרֶת) watch, a certain portion of the day or the night.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3a:11">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>על כל מ׳ ומ׳</he> at the beginning of every watch.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 3a:11">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite> <he>שלש מ׳ בלילה</he> the night is divided into three watches.
